name: Priya Sharma
text: The Banarasi silk saree exceeded all expectations. The craftsmanship is extraordinary — you can feel the heritage in every thread.

name: Ananya Patel
text: My bridal lehenga was absolutely stunning. The attention to detail in the embroidery made me feel like a queen on my special day.

name: Meera Reddy
text: I've ordered multiple times and the quality is consistently excellent. Their Chanderi suits are my absolute go-to for festive occasions.

name: Sneha Gupta
text: The fabric quality is top-notch. Delivery was a bit delayed, but the product itself is worth the wait. Highly recommended!

name: Kavya Iyer
text: Bought the Kanjivaram for my mother. She was in tears seeing the traditional motifs. Vastra truly understands ethnic wear.

name: Riya Malhotra
text: The packaging itself felt so premium. The emerald gown fit perfectly and the color is even more vibrant in person.
